description: Pre-registered arms for docs/eval/model-upgrade-test-plan.md. Every stage's model is set explicitly on every arm (dedup included); caching is off and the output cap identical everywhere, so the model (and, for FLASH38_LOW, the thinking level) is the only variable. 32768 is gemini-4-argon's outputTokenLimit from models.get (verified 2026-11-12), the lowest of the three models, so the cap binds on all of them equally.
